brand_truth: One sewing machine and one roll of canvas in a Montagu village cottage in 1992, from a family upholstery trade that once dressed Nassau's grand hotels; today every awning, top and cushion is cut and sewn at Raphia Close.
buyer: Nassau homeowners with terraces, restaurant and hotel managers, boat owners and captains; they fear fabric that fails in a season and waiting months, and compare with ordering from Florida.

direction.lane: P09 Shipyard steel (light ground, navy field, sun-yellow marker)
direction.why: A family workshop with nine real products and good real photos sells best like Aesop: the inventory, honestly photographed, is the hero, with a pinned index as navigation. Navy from their truck and canopies.
